## About this round

NiYA x Cascador Founders Programme (Abuja), announced 10 Nov 2026 by FMYD/NiYA and Cascador: NGN 1 million non-dilutive growth capital for this founder's business (TechBuild names 'ParaLearn (Parakletus Hub Nigeria)'; founder Evander Ikechukwu). TechBuild.Africa describes the award as non-dilutive growth capital; Vanguard (23 Aug 2026 programme report) describes the programme as grants with Cascador as funder/donor. Amount disclosed in NGN only; no USD amount sourced. Date basis: TechBuild article publication 2026-11-10 ('announced today').
